alarm_target: alarm (out, in, noise, other) vs normal; the target that the device field lrate reproduces
note_leak_vs_nonleak: lrate = 90 for out/in/noise/other; separates normal rows only
provenance: 누수확율 (leak rate): over a two-hour early-morning window each day the sensor checks for a leak 10 times; the share of checks whose response exceeds a set threshold is reported as a probability. Generated automatically by the leak-detection sensor. Integer 0-90.
